query: DELETE r FROM rankingsSubmissions r INNER JOIN ( SELECT sponsorId, MAX(submittedAt) as maxDate FROM rankingsSubmissions GROUP BY sponsorId ) latest ON r.sponsorId = latest.sponsorId WHERE r.submittedAt < latest.maxDate;
